page_summary: This page discusses the need for enhanced workforce capabilities in cybersecurity across organizational levels in ports. It emphasizes the importance of regular role-based awareness training, specialized training for cybersecurity personnel, measuring training effectiveness through behavioral metrics, and translating cyber risk into financial terms to build a compelling business case for investment in cybersecurity. Recommendations aim to foster a security-conscious culture and improve overall cyber resilience in the maritime sector.

regions.description: Text discussing workforce capabilities, training recommendations, and the importance of cybersecurity investment.
